message:
As we navigate our busy lives, it's easy to forget that our technology might not always be reliable—especially in a pinch. We’ve all experienced that moment when our phones die just when we need them most. That’s why it’s so important for us to familiarize ourselves with essential safety skills. 

This resource offers practical tips that can help us feel more confident and prepared, no matter the situation. Let’s take a moment to learn together and keep those basics in mind!
